author: Tiomun
quote:
The games terrible. From a compleatly unbiased point of view. Its incredibly slow. The movement mechanice, the combat, the syory lone, the massive amount of rediculous mini games for ever single remedial task. Which you will spend yhe fors 6 to 8 hours doing. Not joking.

For an open world game. Tgey force it onto a monorail questline. You can not do anything meaningful in the game without progressing the main syory. And the main syory is absolutely terrible.

Their no player freedom or even the illusion of any in the quests because theirs 0 ZERO played based decisions when it comes to anytjimg between worst gf / baby mama of the century and her simp.

The characters are 1 dimensional, and flacid. The male characters especialy feel like they were writen by people who have no idea what being a man is like. These arnt even new age men. They feel like scarecrows pretending to be men. And all the women are psychos. Prety sure Mandy is a canibal...

I was so bored i wasted a extra hour trying to see if i could find the house she was arguing with the neighbor about being always rented out. I think she murders the tenants. That side thought was more enguaging than getting rum for the neighbor, collecting rent  or fixing the house. Which is all their is to do.

The compleatly missed the mark on what realisum to focus on, all while cutting out all gtas legendary core gameplay fun.

If you want a flip this house cozy simulator, its totaly worth the $80. Otherwise wait for the pc release or port and the modders to fix the quests and gameplay flaws.
